title: под- and от-: up to, and away from

blocks.text: The preposition к (to, towards, in the direction of …) always requires the dative case and is widely used with verbs of motion (the so-called "going verbs"). a) After a verb of motion, к, followed by a noun denoting a person, indicates going to see that person at his place: Я иду к полковнику. (I am going to the Colonel; to the Colonel's — his office, home, place). b) After a verb of motion, к, followed by a noun denoting an object or a place, indicates motion toward that object or place: Студент идёт к доске. Самолёты летят к морю. Мы идём к реке (к озеру).

Verbs of motion with the prefix под- denote approaching to an object, a place or a person and require the preposition к + dative case: Я подхожу к столу. Рядовой подходит к сержанту. Мы подъезжаем к городу. Verbs of motion with the prefix от- denote moving away from an object, a place or a person and require the preposition от + genitive case: Я отхожу от автомобиля. Студент отходит от учителя. Грузовик отъезжает от магазина.

rows: Он подошёл к девушке, чтобы спросить её номер. — He approached the girl to ask for her number. Other: Подвезти – give someone a lift: Он подвёз меня до центра. — He took me (as far as) downtown.
**от-, ото-** — Withdrawal a short distance away. Antonym: под-

Мальчик отошёл от незнакомца, который предложил ему конфеты. — The boy stepped back from the stranger who had offered him candy. Other: With transitive verbs, delivering or dropping something off (agent does not remain): Я отнесу книги в библиотеку, потом приду. — I'll drop the book off at the library, then come.

blocks.text: Подвозить — подвезти — to bring up to (by vehicle), to haul up to, to give a lift; относить — отнести — to take to (on foot); отвозить — отвезти — to take (haul) to; отводить — отвести — to take (lead) to. Note that the verbs "относить", "отвозить" and "отводить" are seldom used as opposites of the verbs with the prefix "под-". Their most common meaning is: "to take an object (or person) to a certain place and leave it there". Thus:

items: I took (on foot) the letter to the post office.
I took (by vehicle) money to the bank.
I took (walked with) my son to school.

Antonym: от- Example: Он подошёл к девушке, чтобы спросить её номер. — He approached the girl to ask for her number. Prepositional phrases: к + dat.; до + gen.» — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» § Verbs of motion (CC BY-SA 4.0).  «Verbs of motion with the prefix под- denote approaching to an object, a place or a person and require the preposition к + dative case: Я подхожу к столу. Рядовой подходит к сержанту. Мы подъезжаем к городу.» — DLI, Lesson 29.  The other choice: **отходите** (**отходить**) has the prefix от-, ото- — Withdrawal a short distance away.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
